# Code generated by Termwright. DO NOT EDIT - Termwright writes this file again when tests are saved.
#
# twtest.tcl - the helper of Termwright's generated TCL tests (Tcl 8.6, no extra packages).
# Each step is sent to the running Termwright (its local API: commands log in with the sessions'
# saved logins, requests go through API sessions, SNMP uses the sessions' SNMP settings); the answer
# is checked here. Output is TAP: "ok N - step" / "not ok N - step" with "# ..." lines.
#
# Environment: TERMWRIGHT_API and TERMWRIGHT_KEY (else mcp.json in Termwright's data folder);
# TW_TESTBED=testbeds/lab.yaml; TW_VAR_<name>=<value> for {{name}}.

package require Tcl 8.6
package require http

namespace eval tw {
    variable root [file dirname [file dirname [file dirname [file normalize [info script]]]]]
    variable vars {}
    variable n 0
    variable failed 0
    variable stopped 0
    variable errors {}
    variable skip 0
    variable ans {}
}

# ---- JSON (values are tagged: {o dict} {a list} {s text} {n number} {b true|false} {z}) ----

proc tw::jparse {text} {
    set i 0
    set v [tw::_jval $text i]
    return $v
}

proc tw::_jws {text iv} {
    upvar $iv i
    while {$i < [string length $text] && [string is space [string index $text $i]]} { incr i }
}

proc tw::_jval {text iv} {
    upvar $iv i
    tw::_jws $text i
    set c [string index $text $i]
    switch -- $c {
        "\{" {
            incr i
            set d {}
            tw::_jws $text i
            if {[string index $text $i] eq "\}"} { incr i; return [list o $d] }
            while 1 {
                tw::_jws $text i
                set k [lindex [tw::_jval $text i] 1]
                tw::_jws $text i
                incr i ;# :
                dict set d $k [tw::_jval $text i]
                tw::_jws $text i
                set c [string index $text $i]
                incr i
                if {$c eq "\}"} { return [list o $d] }
                if {$c ne ","} { error "bad JSON at $i" }
            }
        }
        "\[" {
            incr i
            set l {}
            tw::_jws $text i
            if {[string index $text $i] eq "\]"} { incr i; return [list a $l] }
            while 1 {
                lappend l [tw::_jval $text i]
                tw::_jws $text i
                set c [string index $text $i]
                incr i
                if {$c eq "\]"} { return [list a $l] }
                if {$c ne ","} { error "bad JSON at $i" }
            }
        }
        "\"" {
            incr i
            set s ""
            while {$i < [string length $text]} {
                set c [string index $text $i]
                if {$c eq "\""} { incr i; return [list s $s] }
                if {$c eq "\\"} {
                    incr i
                    set e [string index $text $i]
                    switch -- $e {
                        n { append s "\n" } t { append s "\t" } r { append s "\r" } b { append s "\b" } f { append s "\f" }
                        u { append s [format %c [scan [string range $text [expr {$i+1}] [expr {$i+4}]] %x]]; incr i 4 }
                        default { append s $e }
                    }
                } else {
                    append s $c
                }
                incr i
            }
            error "bad JSON string"
        }
        t { incr i 4; return {b true} }
        f { incr i 5; return {b false} }
        n { incr i 4; return {z} }
        default {
            if {![regexp -- {\A-?[0-9][0-9.eE+-]*} [string range $text $i end] num]} { error "bad JSON at $i" }
            incr i [string length $num]
            return [list n $num]
        }
    }
}

proc tw::jstr {s} {
    return "\"[string map [list \\ \\\\ \" \\\" \n \\n \r \\r \t \\t] $s]\""
}

# JSON path: a.b[0].c, ["key"], [-1], length. Returns {found text}.
proc tw::jpath {doc path} {
    set path [string trimleft [string trim $path] {$.}]
    set cur $doc
    foreach {all key idx q} [regexp -all -inline {([^.\[\]]+)|\[(\d+|-1)\]|\["([^"]*)"\]} $path] {
        if {$idx ne ""} {
            if {[lindex $cur 0] ne "a"} { return {0 {}} }
            set l [lindex $cur 1]
            if {$idx < 0} { set idx [expr {[llength $l] + $idx}] }
            if {$idx < 0 || $idx >= [llength $l]} { return {0 {}} }
            set cur [lindex $l $idx]
            continue
        }
        if {$q ne ""} { set key $q }
        switch -- [lindex $cur 0] {
            o {
                set d [lindex $cur 1]
                if {![dict exists $d $key]} {
                    if {$key eq "length"} { return [list 1 [dict size $d]] }
                    return {0 {}}
                }
                set cur [dict get $d $key]
            }
            a {
                if {$key ne "length"} { return {0 {}} }
                return [list 1 [llength [lindex $cur 1]]]
            }
            default { return {0 {}} }
        }
    }
    switch -- [lindex $cur 0] {
        s - n - b { return [list 1 [lindex $cur 1]] }
        z { return {1 null} }
    }
    return [list 1 [tw::jdump $cur]]
}

proc tw::jdump {v} {
    switch -- [lindex $v 0] {
        o { set p {}; dict for {k x} [lindex $v 1] { lappend p "[tw::jstr $k]:[tw::jdump $x]" }; return "\{[join $p ,]\}" }
        a { set p {}; foreach x [lindex $v 1] { lappend p [tw::jdump $x] }; return "\[[join $p ,]\]" }
        s { return [tw::jstr [lindex $v 1]] }
        z { return null }
    }
    return [lindex $v 1]
}

# ---- settings ----

proc tw::endpoint {} {
    global env
    if {[info exists env(TERMWRIGHT_API)] && [info exists env(TERMWRIGHT_KEY)] && $env(TERMWRIGHT_KEY) ne ""} {
        return [list [string trimright $env(TERMWRIGHT_API) /] $env(TERMWRIGHT_KEY)]
    }
    if {[info exists env(TERMWRIGHT_HOME)]} {
        set d $env(TERMWRIGHT_HOME)
    } elseif {$::tcl_platform(os) eq "Darwin"} {
        set d [file join $env(HOME) Library "Application Support" Termwright]
    } elseif {$::tcl_platform(platform) eq "windows"} {
        set d [file join $env(APPDATA) Termwright]
    } else {
        set d [file join $env(HOME) .config Termwright]
    }
    if {[catch {set f [open [file join $d mcp.json]]; set t [read $f]; close $f}]} {
        error "Termwright is not running with its Local API on; or set TERMWRIGHT_API and TERMWRIGHT_KEY"
    }
    set ep [lindex [tw::jparse $t] 1]
    set url [string trimright [lindex [dict get $ep url] 1] /]
    regsub {/mcp$} $url {} url
    return [list "$url/api/v1" [lindex [dict get $ep token] 1]]
}

proc tw::read_testbed {path} {
    variable root
    variable vars
    if {[file pathtype $path] ne "absolute" && ![file exists $path]} { set path [file join $root $path] }
    set f [open $path]
    set stack {}
    foreach raw [split [read $f] "\n"] {
        set line [string trim $raw]
        if {$line eq "" || [string index $line 0] eq "#" || [string first : $line] < 0} continue
        set indent [expr {[string length $raw] - [string length [string trimleft $raw " \t"]]}]
        while {[llength $stack] && [lindex $stack end 0] >= $indent} { set stack [lrange $stack 0 end-1] }
        set c [string first : $line]
        set k [string trim [string trim [string range $line 0 [expr {$c-1}]]] "\"'"]
        if {[llength $stack]} { set k "[lindex $stack end 1].$k" }
        set v [string trim [string range $line [expr {$c+1}] end]]
        if {[set h [string first " #" $v]] >= 0} { set v [string trim [string range $v 0 $h-1]] }
        if {$v eq ""} { lappend stack [list $indent $k]; continue }
        dict set vars $k [string trim $v "\"'"]
    }
    close $f
}

proc tw::fill {s} {
    variable vars
    set out ""
    while {[regexp -indices {\{\{\s*([\w.\-]+)\s*\}\}} $s all name]} {
        set k [string range $s {*}$name]
        append out [string range $s 0 [lindex $all 0]-1]
        if {[dict exists $vars $k]} { append out [dict get $vars $k] } else { append out [string range $s {*}$all] }
        set s [string range $s [lindex $all 1]+1 end]
    }
    return "$out$s"
}

# ---- tests and steps ----

# tw::test name vars params body: runs body once (or once per params dict); the testbed's and
# TW_VAR_ values win over params, which win over vars.
proc tw::test {name defaults params body} {
    global env
    if {![llength $params]} { set params [list {}] }
    foreach p $params {
        variable vars [dict merge $defaults $p]
        if {[info exists env(TW_TESTBED)] && $env(TW_TESTBED) ne ""} { tw::read_testbed $env(TW_TESTBED) }
        foreach k [array names env TW_VAR_*] { dict set vars [string range $k 7 end] $env($k) }
        variable stopped 0
        set label $name
        if {[dict size $p]} {
            set kv {}
            foreach k [lsort [dict keys $p]] { lappend kv "$k=[dict get $p $k]" }
            append label " \[[join $kv {, }]\]"
        }
        puts "# $label"
        uplevel 1 $body
    }
}

proc tw::step {name continue body} {
    variable n
    variable stopped
    variable errors {}
    variable failed
    variable skip $stopped
    incr n
    set name [tw::fill $name]
    if {$skip} { puts "ok $n - $name # SKIP an earlier step failed"; return }
    if {[catch {uplevel 1 $body} err]} { lappend errors $err }
    if {[llength $errors]} {
        incr failed
        puts "not ok $n - $name"
        foreach e $errors { foreach l [split $e "\n"] { puts "#   $l" } }
        if {!$continue} { set stopped 1 }
    } else {
        puts "ok $n - $name"
    }
}

proc tw::fail {msg} { variable errors; lappend errors $msg }

proc tw::_send {stepjson} {
    variable ans
    lassign [tw::endpoint] api key
    set tok [http::geturl "$api/tools/tests" -method POST -type application/json -timeout 900000 \
        -headers [list Authorization "Bearer $key"] -query "\{\"action\":\"step\",\"step\":$stepjson\}"]
    set code [http::ncode $tok]
    set body [encoding convertfrom utf-8 [http::data $tok]]
    set st [http::status $tok]
    http::cleanup $tok
    if {$st ne "ok"} { error "Termwright: $st" }
    if {$code != 200} { error "Termwright: $code $body" }
    set res [lindex [dict get [lindex [tw::jparse $body] 1] result] 1]
    set ans [lindex [tw::jparse $res] 1]
    if {[dict exists $ans error] && [lindex [dict get $ans error] 1] ne ""} { error [lindex [dict get $ans error] 1] }
}

proc tw::_get {k} {
    variable ans
    if {[dict exists $ans $k]} { return [lindex [dict get $ans $k] 1] }
    return ""
}

proc tw::run {session command {prompt ""} {timeout 0}} {
    tw::_send "\{\"run\":\{\"session\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill $session]],\"command\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill $command]],\"prompt\":[tw::jstr $prompt]\},\"timeout\":$timeout\}"
}

# tw::http url ?-session s? ?-method m? ?-body b? ?-headers {k v ...}? ?-environment e? ?-collection c? ?-timeout n?
proc tw::http {url args} {
    set o [dict merge {-session "" -method GET -body "" -headers {} -environment "" -collection "" -timeout 0} $args]
    set h {}
    dict for {k v} [dict get $o -headers] { lappend h "[tw::jstr $k]:[tw::jstr [tw::fill $v]]" }
    tw::_send "\{\"http\":\{\"session\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill [dict get $o -session]]],\"environment\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill [dict get $o -environment]]],\"collection\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill [dict get $o -collection]]],\"method\":[tw::jstr [dict get $o -method]],\"url\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill $url]],\"headers\":\{[join $h ,]\},\"body\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill [dict get $o -body]]]\},\"timeout\":[dict get $o -timeout]\}"
}

# tw::snmp session op oids ?values? ?timeout?   (values: a list of {oid type value})
proc tw::snmp {session op oids {values {}} {timeout 0}} {
    set o {}
    foreach x $oids { lappend o [tw::jstr [tw::fill $x]] }
    set v {}
    foreach x $values { lappend v "\{\"oid\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill [lindex $x 0]]],\"type\":[tw::jstr [lindex $x 1]],\"value\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill [lindex $x 2]]]\}" }
    tw::_send "\{\"snmp\":\{\"session\":[tw::jstr [tw::fill $session]],\"op\":[tw::jstr $op],\"oids\":\[[join $o ,]\],\"values\":\[[join $v ,]\]\},\"timeout\":$timeout\}"
}

proc tw::contains {text} {
    set t [tw::fill $text]
    if {[string first $t [tw::_get output]] < 0} { tw::fail "expected the output to contain \"$t\"\n[tw::_get output]" }
}

proc tw::not_contains {text} {
    set t [tw::fill $text]
    if {[string first $t [tw::_get output]] >= 0} { tw::fail "expected the output not to contain \"$t\"" }
}

proc tw::matches {pattern} {
    set p [tw::fill $pattern]
    if {![regexp -- $p [tw::_get output]]} { tw::fail "expected the output to match $p\n[tw::_get output]" }
}

proc tw::status {code} {
    set s [tw::_get status]
    if {$s eq ""} { set s 0 }
    if {$s != $code} { tw::fail "expected status $code, got $s" }
}

proc tw::max_ms {ms} {
    if {[tw::_get ms] > $ms} { tw::fail "expected at most $ms ms, took [tw::_get ms] ms" }
}

# tw::value kind subject -> {found text raw}; kind field (regular expression with a group), json (a path) or oid.
proc tw::value {kind subject} {
    variable ans
    set s [tw::fill $subject]
    switch -- $kind {
        field {
            set m [regexp -inline -- $s [tw::_get output]]
            if {![llength $m]} { return {0 {} {}} }
            return [list 1 [lindex $m [expr {[llength $m] > 1 ? 1 : 0}]] {}]
        }
        json {
            if {[catch {set doc [tw::jparse [tw::_get output]]}]} { return {0 {} {}} }
            lassign [tw::jpath $doc $s] ok t
            return [list $ok $t {}]
        }
        oid {
            set s [string trimleft [string trim $s] .]
            set rows {}
            if {[dict exists $ans rows] && [lindex [dict get $ans rows] 0] eq "a"} { set rows [lindex [dict get $ans rows] 1] }
            foreach pass {1 2} {
                foreach r $rows {
                    set d [lindex $r 1]
                    foreach k {oid name value display} { set $k [expr {[dict exists $d $k] ? [lindex [dict get $d $k] 1] : ""}] }
                    if {$pass == 1} {
                        if {$oid eq $s || $name eq $s} { return [list 1 $display $value] }
                    } else {
                        set nm $name
                        if {[string first :: $nm] >= 0 && [string first :: $s] < 0} { set nm [lindex [split [string map {:: \x01} $nm] \x01] 1] }
                        if {$nm eq $s || [string match "$s.*" $nm] || [string match "$s.*" $oid]} { return [list 1 $display $value] }
                    }
                }
            }
            return {0 {} {}}
        }
    }
    error "unknown value kind $kind"
}

# tw::check kind subject op ?want?   op: equals, not_equals, greater, less, exists, missing, found
proc tw::check {kind subject op {want ""}} {
    lassign [tw::value $kind $subject] ok t raw
    set w [tw::fill $want]
    set what "$kind [tw::fill $subject]"
    set num [expr {$raw ne "" ? $raw : $t}]
    switch -- $op {
        equals     { set pass [expr {$ok && ($t eq $w || ($raw ne "" && $raw eq $w))}] }
        not_equals { set pass [expr {!($t eq $w || ($raw ne "" && $raw eq $w))}] }
        greater    { set pass [expr {$ok && [string is double -strict $num] && $num > $w}] }
        less       { set pass [expr {$ok && [string is double -strict $num] && $num < $w}] }
        exists - found { set pass $ok }
        missing    { set pass [expr {!$ok}] }
        default    { error "unknown check $op" }
    }
    if {!$pass} { tw::fail "$what: expected $op $w, got \"$t\"" }
}

proc tw::save {var kind subject} {
    variable vars
    lassign [tw::value $kind $subject] ok t
    if {$ok} { dict set vars $var $t }
}

# tw::done: ends the script; exit code 1 when a step failed.
proc tw::done {} {
    variable n
    variable failed
    puts "1..$n"
    exit [expr {$failed > 0}]
}
